title: Proactive Data Product – Definition v1.0
description: Definition of the term "proactive data product", version 1.0, first published by INFORMULA Kft. on 5 November 2026 in Budapest (informula.hu/proactive-data-product). A proactive data product is a real-time data product of a business entity with a named owner and a contract, which serves its current state on request (state view) and publishes business-meaningful events on its own (event view).
